stories.title: Meta outlook revised downward by S&P on cash flow and capex concerns
stories.summary: Meta has been given a negative outlook by S&P Global Ratings due to the company's hefty capital expenditures and negative free cash flow. S&P said the outlook reflects uncertainty around elevated capital expenditures and future cash flow. Meta reported quarterly earnings last week.

stories.title: This cybersecurity stock will be the next to join the S&P 500
stories.summary: Okta is slated to join the index on Wednesday, replacing Kenvue.

stories.summary: Safe-haven gold fell to its lowest price in a year, despite jitters around the potential for fresh Middle East attacks following the U.S. midterm elections on Tuesday. stories.summary: More interest-rate hikes are needed to fight inflation, Fed officials say. The comments show there is no settled policy at the central bank when it comes to communicating to the public about the economic outlook. stories.title: In a wild October for markets, these stocks were the biggest winners and losers
stories.summary: Many Big Tech stocks were hit hard but the S&P 500 showed strength under the surface, with a majority of stocks showing gains for the month. The S&P 500 SPX declined 0.9% for October, even though 72% of stocks in the large-cap benchmark index were up for the month.

stories.summary: Intel’s PC business is under pressure as memory-chip prices dent demand and as corporate IT teams have less budget for laptops. sports.title: Sources: Walter, Kushner finalize terms of Lakers sale at $12.5B valuation
sports.summary: Lakers owner Mark Walter and Thrive Capital founder Josh Kushner met Thursday to finalize the transaction and are expected to sign the formal agreement soon, sources told ESPN.

sports.title: Morant, hurt against Grizzlies, to miss at least four weeks
sports.summary: Trail Blazers guard Ja Morant sustained a left hamstring strain in his first game against the Grizzlies, his former team, and will be out at least four weeks.

sports.title: Beer-fueled Brewers take to streets, continue World Series party
sports.summary: Tens of thousands of exuberant Brewers fans flooded the streets of downtown Milwaukee to celebrate the franchise's first World Series title with a parade and victory rally.

sports.title: UConn's Hurley gets 2-year extension, now signed through 2032
sports.summary: UConn coach Dan Hurley has signed a two-year extension that puts him under contract through the 2031-32 season and maintains his annual salary of roughly $8 million.
